headline: July 2026 Recap
subhead: // 2026-07 recap // · NET +$412 · 21 active days · BCA · CRYPTO
body: You spent $1,240 across 14 categories in July — 12% less than June, and dining out alone took 23% of the total. Your BCA wallet absorbed most of the month's spending while the crypto vault quietly grew. Rent on the 1st and a Netflix renewal on the 14th were your two biggest fixed hits, and Maya still owes you $85 from last month's groceries.
